Dad: How did the pupils help on the trip?
Eva: Leo checked the group tickets.
Dad: Did Jo read the boat time?
Eva: No, Jo showed the new pupil the route. Sam read the boat time.
Dad: What about Ruby?
Eva: Ruby carried the guidebooks.
Dad: And Alex?
Eva: Alex counted the bags before we returned. He did not drive the coach.
Dad: Did anyone buy new shoes?
Eva: No. We all helped the group in those five ways.
